headline: N-central zero-days now targeted as N-able rushes patches; CI secret stealer hit 1,806+ GitHub repos; Apache HTTP/2 RCE CVE-2026-119618

bullets.text: New: SecurityWeek reports hackers are targeting the N-central zero-days a researcher published, while N-able rushes out patches (3 outlets). ScreenConnect rogue-client attacks have hit at least 288 endpoints across 48 organizations, breaching MSPs.

Also new: BleepingComputer reports attackers planting GSocket on Linux servers for persistent access; a critical Red Hat Quay flaw could expose private container images; MongoDB pre-auth flaw CVE-2026-118383 can crash lagging servers on failover.
An attacker used 4,837 hijacked GitHub accounts to run a CI secret stealer in more than 1,806 repositories, per The Hacker News. Treat CI secrets exposed to workflows in affected repos as at risk.
Critical Apache HTTP Server flaw CVE-2026-119618 in HTTP/2 could let unauthenticated attackers execute code remotely, per Wiz and The Hacker News. The brief gives no fixed release.

KEV due 11-13: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (exploited, 4 outlets) and Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935. Due today 11-12: OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158, GPUStack, FreeSwitch, IBM Aspera Faspex. Due 11-24: Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave, Outlook, Chromium.

Still active: Maersk confirmed data theft amid a $5M WhiteArmor extortion demand; critical Xen Orchestra flaws exploited (3 outlets); Vanderbilt on lockdown after ransomware (6 outlets). SITCON 3 holds; the week runs 1.07x the 90-day average.

actions: N-central: apply N-able's patches as they ship, keep the console off the internet, and review admin and agent activity for compromise.
Inventory ScreenConnect instances, remove unknown or rogue clients, patch, and review session logs.
Review GitHub audit logs and recent workflow runs for unfamiliar accounts; rotate secrets exposed to CI and limit workflows from outside contributors.
Find internet-facing Apache HTTP Server hosts with HTTP/2 enabled; restrict exposure and patch as soon as a fixed release or distro package ships.
Hunt for GSocket on Linux servers; check Red Hat Quay and MongoDB deployments for vendor fixes.
Barracuda ESG and Ivanti Connect Secure fixes by 11-13; OpenSSH, GPUStack, FreeSwitch, Aspera Faspex today; keep Xen Orchestra off the internet.
